title: Contract seven separated staged544 A2 blocks
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Seven separated three-ADD blocks in each frozen PR3734 provider contract to two ADDs. Beyond #3998's credited consecutive A1858 contraction, this removes **seven forward and five inverse-cleanup ADD records**. The complete recursive histogram remains `{1:2440,2:725,3:224,4:102,5:20,8:8}`: 3,519 children and rank mass 5,134. No recursive-moment, measured runtime or κ improvement is claimed.

Only `research/staged544-separated-a2/` is added: 19 files, one canonical-parent commit `f408e09df300b575235f7f77f81948071397e16d`. Each intervening event must avoid all three selected registers; no prelude, centre, section or native-warp boundary is crossed. The seven new blocks retain their exact ordered frames. Native descriptors/order, helper entrances/exits, wrappers, cuts and initial corrections remain unchanged. No register or buffer is allocated.

`PROOF.md` gives rational A2 identities, strict disjoint gathering and projected inverse-cleanup composition on arbitrary dirty inputs. `data.json` binds every gate, replacement, full invoice and canonical reconstructed-word/cleanup digest. The two B deletions write output targets and save no cleanup ADD; the five restore deletions save five. Relative to raw PR3734, the combined saving including #3998 is eight forward plus six cleanup records. Some coefficients are 2 or 1/2; these are scalar records, not asserted unit-native instructions.
